label: Fires at D1 after an unrewarded visit to S2, fading over the episode.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * ep_trial
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == -1) * (in_rew == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("state", -2) == 2)
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO and D2). Magnitude is set by the previous trial: large when the agent reached S2 and was not rewarded (either a1-rare or a2-common, similar size), near zero after any rewarded trial or any S1 outcome. The S2-unrewarded response shrinks roughly linearly over the episode (ep_trial interaction, multiplicative not just the additive timing baseline). The free fit adds: a bigger response when the trial before was also unrewarded (two losses in a row), a small positive dependence on belief_lo (more when the observer believes S1 is good, i.e. S2 loss consistent with S1 good), and firing on window-first D1s after an unrewarded trial whose state is unknown in the window. No future or model-output variables used.
